CP2.4c: pure projected-screen inclusive bounds at 0x61E09A..0x61E0AC, not a map-cell test. Role_TickCommandStateAndDispatchPlayback calls with margin2 at 0x67274A/0x67280E and registers the role only on success. Off-grid tiles can be visible; distant off-screen roles are not inserted.

Depth insert of child N into active render deque +0x74 (see 20_notes Game_Map/world_render_contract_5517.md). 1) N.type!=2: first active type-2 E whose footprint contains N.tile adopts N (InsertChildForDepth). 2) Walk active list: x-overlap([x-w+1,x]) -> if N.y<E.y backward-insert else extend insert-after cursor; y-overlap -> if N.x<E.x backward-insert else extend cursor. Cursor scans stop at first element whose x+y differs from E and >= / <= N.x+N.y. 3) No cursor: insert before first E with N.x+N.y < E.x+E.y, else push back.

CP2.4c: full routine revalidated for off-grid role input. Reads virtual signed int32 tile pairs; type2 footprint adoption uses 0x644E0E, otherwise axis overlap and signed wrapping int32 tile sums. No grid dimensions, GetCell or in-map admission gate is used. Overlap is wrapped (a-spanA-b+1)<=0 and its converse (0x635C5E..0x635C79), not an unbounded subtraction.

CP2.4c: current cached screen point inverse-projects to a tile; call 0x650940 returns NULL for off-grid. TEST/JE at 0x650947/0x650949 goes directly to epilogue 0x65097C with EAX still0. Thus the terrain-delta contribution is0; do not infer all independent vertical offsets or motion-arc terms are0.

Per-frame per-entity tick+render hook. Called by the game loop for every visible CRole. Only in-process caller of player RoleView vtable +0x0C (UpdateRolePartMotionsForAction) and +0x28 (SharedRenderComposite).

=== Verified phase walk ===
1. Entry guards: status 0x02 (hidden), subclass vtable+0x60 veto, or missing RoleView return early.
2. Computes projected screen anchor/elevation/facing and calls RoleView +0x10 to set pose.
3. Runs the action-dispatch refresh state machine and calls RoleView +0x0C for current part motions; paralyzed status 0x2E uses action 0x390 and a wrapped auxiliary frame through RoleView +0x04 selector 0x0A.
4. Selects direct rendering or the optional 256x256 offscreen target path. The offscreen path calls player RoleView +0x20 with selector 2 and a null effect name; the verified RoleView implementation ignores that combination.
5. Pushes cached helmet/body/left-weapon lookup IDs and calls RoleView +0x28 for the shared composite.
6. Optionally renders a scaled/tinted secondary pass when role[0x7C]==1.
7. Draws attached effect-animation overlays, chat/floating strings, HP bar, and name bar.
8. After rendering, mutates named part effects for the next frame in this exact order:
   - status 0x5F aiming: mounted status 0x32 removes body/flagmanaim then ensures mount/flagmountaim; unmounted removes mount/flagmountaim then ensures body/flagmanaim. Without aiming, removes mount/flagmountaim then body/flagmanaim.
   - status 0x76 war-flag escort: mounted removes body/WarFlagEscortStatusNoMount then ensures mount/WarFlagEscortStatusMount; unmounted removes mount/WarFlagEscortStatusMount then ensures body/WarFlagEscortStatusNoMount. Without escort, removes mount/WarFlagEscortStatusMount then body/WarFlagEscortStatusNoMount.
   Selectors are body=4 and mount=8. CRole__EnsureRoleViewPartEffectInstanceBySelectorAndName forwards to player RoleView +0x1C; CRole__RemoveRoleViewPartEffectInstanceBySelectorAndName forwards to +0x20. These are named effect operations, not mesh-visibility or numeric variant writes.

Key CRole offsets: +0x60 action-refresh latch; +0x64 action-start tick; +0x70..+0x7F 128 status bits; +0x104..+0x114 cached helmet/body/left-weapon lookup IDs; +0x1A4 current action; +0x1A8 facing; +0x1AC frame count; +0x1B0 randomized frame offset; +0x3B4 IRoleView; +0x420 render-target state; +0x42C cached bitmap; +0x430 HP bar; +0x434 name bar.

CP2.4c: vertical locals initialize0 at 0x64F66B/0x64F66E. Ordinary supported idle/walk action path does not sample map altitude. Motion-arc actions and independent offsets remain distinct. Immutable clean-PE tail decoded separately because current BN function coverage is split: FILD [ebp-0x1C] 0x64F832, float argument stores0x64F835/0x64F843, RoleView transform setter call0x64F854. No universal off-map height override is established.

Processes native packet 10005 (size 0x18). It compares the complete u32 commandSelectorRaw at +0x0C to exactly 9. Raw value 9 selects 24-direction normalization and command type 0x18. Every other raw value selects 8-direction normalization; only then the low selector byte equal to 1 selects command type 0x17, otherwise command type 0x16. Thus raw 0x00000109 is an 8-direction/type-0x16 case, not the selector-9 path. Only the low byte of packedDirectionPhase at +0x04 is normalized and consumed as direction; the upper three bytes are retained. For the local hero, movementTick +0x10 is passed to CHero_ProcessMovementAcknowledgementTimestamp before local-coordinate advancement. A resolved remote role receives the selected command type and direction.

CP2.4c: ordinary hero walk adds DWORD delta components at 0x7406DB/0x7406DD modulo2^32 and forwards them without ushort narrowing or overflow rejection to Role_UpdateCoordinateGateAndMapFromTilePair. Gate tile and rendered-role tile fields are distinct; this does not establish interpolation parity.
